nom: Curology Emergency Spot Pimple Patches for Face

segments.sensitive: The one reviewer with sensitive skin reports that cheaper patches broke her out badly and a different premium brand hurt to remove, but these Curology patches worked within three days, stuck without hurting on removal, and helped with redness.

concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report the patches noticeably reduce redness and inflammation around a blemish, often visible after just one night.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers report the patches stick well and remove comfortably without hurting the skin; one reviewer, however, found they adhered strongly enough to facial peach fuzz to make removal a little uncomfortable.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the patches draw out pus or buildup overnight and visibly shrink blemishes by morning; a few reviewers note they work best on a pimple that has already come to a head rather than a deep or undeveloped one, and one reviewer found they absorbed less than other brands, with her pimples refilling.

aspects.libelle: Box arrives damaged, opened, or missing patches
Thin and nearly invisible on skin
Individually sealed packets keep unused patches fresh

extraits.titre: They’re ok, theres better options for cheaper
extraits.texte: I’ve tried several types of pimple patches and these aren’t the worse, but there’s others that I prefer more. These do not seem to absorb gunk as well as the others, my pimples have been refilling which usually never happens. I also have to use several of these on one pimple. Im going back to PanOxyl.

Okay! I already use Curology products. I had terrible hormonal acne in my late 20’s and their products cleared me up for the most part! Due to their prices being higher than I’d like I never got these patches before. I usually use the Walmart brand for $3 and call it a day. Well I decided to purchase a random bundle of patches on Amazon for $10 that came with like 300 patches. They broke me out very bad. I have sensitive skin and I knew it was a gamble. Then I purchased Neutrogena patches and they stuck to my skin so bad I thought they would peel my skin off when I took them off. They didn't work though. So I ordered these curology patches and within 3 day it’s already better! They stick perfectly without hurting when I remove them. They also aren’t super shiny so I can wear them and not feel like it’s extremely noticeable. They help with redness as well. I will absolutely keep these in stock.

extraits.titre: This Product Does Exactky What It Claims!!
extraits.texte: I purchased this as a stocking stuffer for my 20 year old daughter. She is a junior in college and was home for the holidays. I noticed her breakouts had increased and she said she’s starting to get whiteheads/pimples on her chin area and t zone. I saw this package and had heard very good things about this brand from my son who ordered a trial supply for his acne. (19 yo). He had great success with it, so I thought I would get the patches for my daughter to try when she has the occasional breakout. To add, my daughter loves the idea of the patches. She has tried several brands and most seem to help somewhat, but none do what this brand did. She applied a pimple patch to a larger, whitehead pimple. This is much better than squeezing it and risking getting a scar for life! She did this after a shower one night before bed. When she woke up the next morning she was shocked that the pimple patch completely removed all of the whitehead/pus from the pimple, reduced redness completely and her face looked 1000 times better. She was so excited to tell me all about it! It truly was amazing and def a product we will continue to purchase. 10/10 recommend! This brand was created by dermatologist. Their products actually work and the patches did exactly what they promised to do! I highly recommend the patches to anyone that struggles with whiteheads or acne. I recommend these Curology Emergency Spot Pimple Patches to everyone! They actually work. Whenever I have a pimple that's come to a head, I put one on before bed, and by the next morning it has extracted a lot of the buildup and looks much smaller. One thing to keep in mind is that these don't have micro-needles, so they're not the best option for deep, stubborn pimples that haven't developed yet. They work best on pimples that are already a little developed. Overall, these patches have been lifesavers for me. They're easy to use, stay on well overnight, and make a noticeable difference by morning. I'll definitely keep buying them.

These work well to pull out pimple drainage. I like the that I can place them on my skin and do my routine with serums and a moisturizer over it and they don’t move. They are pretty thin, so they taper to the skin and don’t stick up off of it as much as others. Also, I find that these really adhere to peach fuzz more than any other that I’ve used before which makes them a little uncomfortable to take off.

extraits.titre: Most absorbent patch I have tried
extraits.texte: These seem like they absorb more gunk than some other brands I have tried. They seem slightly thinner and more prone to sticking to themselves, which makes them a little more difficult to apply, but they work well. They adhere well, are inconspicuous on my skin and not hard to remove. I have bought brands that include multiple sizes of patch in each box, but have not found the smaller sized ones to be as useful, personally. These were a good unit price. I don’t love that the sheets are enclosed in plastic/foil pouches and that the sheets are plastic. Not sure about the biodegradability of the patches themselves, either, so I try to use them sparingly. Nothing else out there drains the yucky goop out of a swollen pimple as effectively and quickly, though. In order to work they do need to be making direct contact with the goop. These can’t drain a closed papule, but if you can bring it to a head with some benzoyl peroxide cream or a gentle warm compress first that can help. Once the patches have been saturated with exudate it is advisable to change them promptly so they aren’t exerting pressure that could contribute to scarring.

extraits.titre: Sturdy, Flexible, Helpful Patches! Clean Presentation!
extraits.texte: I really like pimple-patches such as Starface for the occasional blemish. They are so much tidier and effective than a liquid treatment (that gets on pillows and linens as you sleep). These arrive nicely boxed and there are four sealed, individual packets here. That means that you can open one and leave the rest sealed and protected. That is the ideal! Each patch is easy to remove from the sheet (which is not the case with all patches) and is super flexible. The patch applies easily and remains put. No matter how much you toss and turn in your sleep, the patch is going nowhere until you remove it. And, you can see the healing after night one! Inflammation and redness is quickly reduced! These make short work of those occasional blemishes. Such a clean and effective treatment. Nice!
